Ravi (CSM): FYI TidalMetrics dropped to ~15% of normal token volume overnight. Saw mention of a "Piggyback" eval from their ML lead in the same slack thread. Need a fast renewal triage. :warning:
redwood-bot: [alert] account_usage_drop: TidalMetrics (acct_8821) - 85% WoW drop. AlertID: UDF-8821-11
Laura (AE): Oof. Who's our champion there now? Any hiring/staff changes?
Ravi (CSM): Champion (Nora) is still main contact but flagged "constrained infra" as reason for flaky results last week. Nora told us they're running a short eval with "OtherModelCo" starting 2026-02-18.
Chen (SE): Telemetry quick peek (requests/day):```
2026-02-14: 7,200
2026-02-15: 6,950
2026-02-16: 1,200
2026-02-17: 900
2026-02-18: 650
```
Marta (CS Ops): Suggested triage: 1) 20m check-in today to surface infra mismatch; 2) offer a constrained parity bench (1-week) with fixed infra to rule out infra vs model quality; 3) provide regression run on their core prompt-set and a short SLO doc for latency/cost. I'll try to book.
Laura (AE): Commercial add: propose a small "env-parity" credit (covers Dedicated-like perf) and an NDA-approved exchange of minimal eval data. We should ask for competitor pilot scope and success metrics on the call.
Chen (SE): I can prepare a minimal perf recipe to reproduce their failing route: pin model to q4_8bit, set KV+prefix cache on, and stabilize batch-size. Quick curl to fetch last 7d usage I sent to the console:```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_TOKEN" \n  "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/accounts/8821/usage?range=7d"
```
Ravi (CSM): Good. Two risks: (A) procurement already running parallel eval and (B) Nora's manager (VP Eng) mentioned cost sensitivity. We need value talk + parity test.
Marta (CS Ops): Booked 20m with Nora for 2026-02-19 09:30 ET. Agenda: quick root-cause checklist, parity offer, timeline for competitor test. Invite links to telemetry & repro recipe.
Laura (AE): On call I'll ask for a 1-week A/B where we control infra for our variant and let them run competitor in their environment. If they can't agree, ask for a single-run evaluation where they run both on same hardware.
Chen (SE): I'll bring a 1-pager showing expected delta from enabling prefix caching + pinned quant variant (sample: latency 120->70ms p50 on retrieval-heavy flows).
Ravi (CSM): Action list: Laura - lead outreach and extract competitor success metrics; Chen - drop repro recipe + one-pager before call; Marta - host invite + add exec-escalation checkbox; Ravi - prep renewal risk note for AM and flag case for low-touch escalate.
Laura (AE): Will aim to confirm pilot scope in the call and request the prompt-set for a quick regression run. 48h outreach window.
redwood-bot: [note] alert acknowledged by Ravi at 2026-02-18T15:12:04Z
Ravi (CSM): If they confirm competitor parity testing, escalate to CS Director for a quick QBR within 5 business days. Case# CS-8821-ENV_PARITY
Marta (CS Ops): noted. Keeping thread tight for handoff.
Laura (AE): 👍 I'll update after the 2/19 check-in.
